successors.name: Kingdom of Prussia
successors.text: the Principality on the Nahe: Cliopatria's cell plus a 12 km radius round Sankt Wendel, the capital that the cell omits (about 450 km2 added against the page's 537 km2 total)

rulers.name: Ernest (Duke Ernest III of Saxe-Coburg-Saalfeld; from 1826 Ernest I of Saxe-Coburg and Gotha)

ledger.x: 1816: Duke Ernest takes possession of the Lichtenberg lands on the Nahe.
1819: the territory becomes the Principality of Lichtenberg.
1834: Duke Ernest sells the principality to Prussia.
1834: the Principality of Lichtenberg ends with the sale to Prussia on 15 August 1834.

certainty.note: The page names the Nahe, Sankt Wendel and Baumholder but no survey line, and Cliopatria draws one grid cell that misses the capital; the outline is approximate.
